name: assistant-ui
description: Shared React component library for the Neuronection assistant family. One package, four apps — family look by default, app flavor via CSS-variable tokens.

paragraphs: Shared React component library for the Assistant family — four sibling apps that AI-help people with career, study, health, and their desktop. One package, four apps: family look by default, app flavor via CSS-variable design tokens. Works in React 18 & 19 and alongside Tailwind 3 or 4 — the library ships precompiled CSS, so your app's Tailwind never compiles library classes.

sibling without sharing a stack. Patterns the apps actually use — provider & model settings blocks, AI affordances (ask/fill/act), date & clock pickers, async comboboxes, file attachment surfaces, chat surfaces & trace panes — live in the package, not copy-pasted in four repos.
